items.item_text: Certified Pharmacy Tech PTCB, upon hire

Completed Pharmacy Technician program 1 year of Hospital Pharmacy and Sterilecompounding experience. If operations allow, may consider training new graduate or non-acute care experienced tech., upon hire
Delivers medications to designated areas accurately and efficiently, including consolidating trips and recognizing priorities
Fills and bills patient cassettes accurately and efficiently, processes patient charges and credits accurately and rapidly into the computer and delivers and exchanges cassettes efficiently
Fills stock, Unit dose medications and medication orders accurately, efficiently and in a timely manner taking into account specific patient needs

Completes outpatient pharmacy functions according to departmental processes which includes but is not limited to: calling in prescription refills to the physician offices and processing take home prescriptions
Stocks take home area, shelves and medication bins and all areas of the pharmacy

Conducts IV preparation functions according to departmental processes using sterile technique. Competency required within 12-months of hire. Competency will be required to transfer into a posted position requiring this skillset.
